name: De Leon Furniture, Inc.
old_description: De Leon Furniture has been family-owned and operated since 1967. We’ve treated every customer like they were a part of our family. Other companies may offer similar services, but our services come with a personal touch.
about:
De Leon Furniture, Inc. has operated from Kansas City, Kansas since 1967, when the deLeon family established the business as a family-owned and operated workshop. The company traces its roots through four generations of furniture building, with the last 45 years spent in the United States.

The shop provides upholstery, refinishing, and restoration services, and also custom builds high-end period furniture as well as unique modern pieces. Woodworking and upholstery form the core of its production, complemented by a line of do-it-yourself products that includes furniture oils, waxes for sprayless finishes, and felt glides for floor protection.

De Leon Furniture serves architects and interior designers, delivering its services through those professionals rather than directly to end consumers. The company works with design professionals on projects that require custom fabrication, restoration, or reupholstery.

The firm emphasizes high quality-control standards and credits its craftsmen as among the best in the business, aiming to provide a personal touch that distinguishes it from larger competitors.
